query: AgentBoard 的核心贡献是什么？
answer: AgentBoard 是一个面向 LLM 智能体分析式评估的综合基准与开源评估框架，提供细粒度进度率指标和全面的评估工具包。
support_quote: we introduce AGENTBOARD, a pioneering comprehensive benchmark and accompanied open-source evaluation framework tailored to analytical evaluation of LLM agents
title: AgentBoard: An Analytical Evaluation Board of Multi-turn LLM Agents

query: AgentBoard 如何衡量中间状态模糊的任务的进度？
answer: AgentBoard 将总目标分解为子目标序列，并引入离散匹配分数来评估中间状态与已定义子目标的接近程度。
support_quote: We mitigate this by introducing a discrete matching score to assess how closely intermediate states align with defined subgoals
title: AgentBoard: An Analytical Evaluation Board of Multi-turn LLM Agents

query: AgentBoard 的评估工具包支持哪些分析功能？
answer: 该工具包支持细粒度进度率跟踪、难易样本性能分解、各子技能表现、长程交互评估、grounding 准确率和轨迹等分析与可视化。
support_quote: supports analysis and visualization on fine-grained progress rates tracking, performance breakdown for hard and easy examples, detailed performance across various sub-skills, long-range interaction assessment, grounding accuracy, and trajectory
title: AgentBoard: An Analytical Evaluation Board of Multi-turn LLM Agents

query: 在 AgentBoard 中，进度率相比成功率有什么优势？
answer: 进度率能区分成功率相近的模型，并且较少受智能体特定特征（如未能生成 finish 动作）的影响。
support_quote: progress rate is often able to differentiate models that have similar success rates
title: AgentBoard: An Analytical Evaluation Board of Multi-turn LLM Agents

query: AgentBoard 如何定义任务中的难易样本？
answer: AgentBoard 根据子目标数量划分难易：子目标数量超过截止值的问题被视为困难问题。
support_quote: problems with a larger number of subgoals than cutoff are viewed as hard
title: AgentBoard: An Analytical Evaluation Board of Multi-turn LLM Agents
